_doc: SectorCare (SC) brand configuration for the Automation Platform — the SINGLE, non-secret source of SC brand facts + design tokens. Mirrors config/brands/RDD.config.json (RDD is the reference implementation). Credentials are NEVER stored here — the SC Klaviyo key loads at runtime from Brands/SC/.env (git-ignored) under env var SC_KLAVIYO_API_KEY. Brand-prefixed env var name gives strict cross-brand isolation.
_sources: Grounded in APPROVED, in-repo references (CLAUDE.md §5 — never invented). 03-Brands MD Files/SC.md is an empty stub, so the SC design system is [Inferred] from the latest approved sends Brands/SC/Campaigns/Weekly/Output/SC-2026-W29.html + SC-2026-W30.html (the visual source of truth until an official SC brand source exists) and the project memory sc-brand-facts. Values are confidence-tagged; [Inferred]/To-be-confirmed items must be confirmed before an SC send.
_status: PARTIAL — sufficient for Klaviyo credential resolution + isolation + live read-only validation (this integration pass). Product source (BigCommerce s-498h0egvgn) is NOT yet wired for SC (no Brands/SC/integration/ folder, no BigCommerce creds in Brands/SC/.env). Full end-to-end SC drafts additionally require: SC calendar rows + an SC product source. See LIVE_SYSTEM_AUDIT / KLAVIYO_INTEGRATION_PLAN.

bigcommerce._note: SHARED BigCommerce store with SS (VERIFIED from project files: SC and SS product images all resolve to store 498h0egvgn — the SAME store — served through two storefronts: sectorcare.com.au for SC, safetysector.com.au for SS). Credentials are NOT duplicated per brand: SC and SS both read the SAME git-ignored shared file (envPath below). Brand separation on the shared catalog is by brand-specific category ids (featuredCategoryIds / calendar topic_category) plus THIS brand's storeDomain for product URLs — NEVER the generic store-wide candidate/recent pool, which would mix SS and SC products. Klaviyo stays fully isolated per brand (see the klaviyo block). Product retrieval is blocked until the shared store's read-only token is added to the shared file, and until SC's category ids are identified from the live catalog.
bigcommerce._categoryNote: VERIFIED live read-only 2026-08-09: SC = channel 1786273 / category tree 2 ('SectorCare'). These tree-2 top-level categories returned live products (wheelchairs, scooters, rollators, bath/toilet/transfer/shower/bed aids). Products resolve to sectorcare.com.au. Note: the catalog also has duplicate SC category names in other trees (e.g. 'Mobility Aids' 174 tree-2 vs 195 tree-1 all-SC); prefer brand-specific category names in the calendar to avoid cross-tree name collisions.
bigcommerce._status: shared-store VALIDATED (live read-only); channel 1786273 / tree 2; SC category ids set

klaviyo._note: Non-secret Klaviyo settings for the SC DRAFT MVP. The SC Klaviyo private key is NEVER stored here — it loads at runtime from Brands/SC/.env (git-ignored) under SC_KLAVIYO_API_KEY. Brand-prefixed env var name enforces isolation from RDD (KLAVIYO_API_KEY) and SS (SS_KLAVIYO_API_KEY). The platform creates DRAFTS ONLY (safety.js no-send guard). Fields tagged 'To be confirmed' are external prerequisites that block SC campaign creation until supplied.
